reports.note: Weak, brief rotation on the ground, kicking up small branches, leaves, and water as the rotation passed over Love Lake. No damage as of now.

Emergency manager and law enforcement reported a brief tornado touchdown west of Deming. No damage was reported. The tornado occurred on BLM land. No survey was conducted. A rating of EFU was given to this tornado.

A tornado developed in the Via Caballero neighborhood in the south central portion of Santa Fe just north of I-25. The tornado traveled northward for approximately 1.4 miles, terminating near the College of Santa Fe. Much of the damage was along Rancho Siringo and Camino Chueco Roads. Damage included broken power poles, uprooted or damaged trees, damage to roofs. Ten homes sustained damaged. This tornado has been given a preliminary rating of EF-1, pending additional information.
Several pics and video of a tornado near Table Mesa in open land on social media. No damage reported. The period of the Tornado report was 8 minutes.
Minor damage to a house, trees down, garage door blown in, and shed damaged.

Approximate start point of a brief EF1 rated tornado. Peak winds estimated to be 110 mph with path width of about 600 yards. The tornado proceeded about 2.3 miles northeast before dissipating just west of Highway 180.

*** 1 INJ *** Approximate start point of an EF-1 rated tornado that moved north through the Heber-Overgaard area. Peak winds estimated to be 110 mph along its 11 minute journey. The path was just over 9 miles with maximum width estimated to be around 350 yards. There was 1 non life-threatening injury reported.
Videos via social media show a brief landspout that occurred south of Animas. A rating of EFO was given for this event. No reports of damage since this was in a remote part of the state.
Emergency manager confirmed brief tornado but remained in open fields with no damage reported.

An EF1 rated tornado developed south of Walker and traveled north-northeast across Walker Road. The estimated maximum wind speed was 105 mph along its 8 mile path. Maximum width was estimated to be 300 yards.

tracks.note: The tornado tracked across open fields and was viewed by several storm chasers. Radar data also indicated the tornado was on the ground. No damage was found in the area.

A tornado developed in the Via Caballero neighborhood in the south central portion of Santa Fe just north of I-25. The tornado traveled northward for approximately 1.5 miles, terminating near the College of Santa Fe. Much of the damage was along Rancho Siringo and Camino Chueco Roads. Damage included broken power poles, uprooted or damaged trees, damage to roofs. Ten homes sustained damaged with one home having the majority of the roof removed and a collapsed wall. This tornado has been given a rating of EF-1 with peak winds of 110 mph.

Verified emergency management and public confirmed tornado damage via video. Broader survey not conducted due to no other damage reports. Minor damage to home, multiple trees uprooted, shed/garage doors blown in and uplifted. Damage consistent with EF-0 indicators.
